title: Replace bullet splitting engine with smart semantic splitting

requirements.text: Remove all existing bullet point splitting logic from notesCleanerFormat.ts including convertToParagraphToPoints, convertToBulletPoints, and definition style bullet formatting functions

quotes: Remove and override all previously implemented logic related to: Convert Paragraph to Points, Convert to Bullet Points, Definition Style bullet formatting

acceptanceCriteria: All previous splitting logic is completely removed from notesCleanerFormat.ts
No traces of the old conjunction-based splitting remain in the codebase

requirements.text: Implement semantic phrase detection that preserves scientific compound terms as single bullets: 'carbon dioxide and water', 'semi permeable membrane', 'low solute concentration', 'high solute concentration' must never be split

quotes: Do NOT create a new bullet point if: the word 'and' appears inside a scientific or descriptive phrase, the phrase contains dependent modifiers
Protect scientific compound terms: semi permeable membrane, low solute concentration, high solute concentration

acceptanceCriteria: Phrases containing 'and' within scientific/technical contexts remain as single bullets
Scientific compound terms with modifiers stay intact
Example 'carbon dioxide and water' produces one bullet, not two

requirements.text: Implement smart splitting logic that only creates multiple bullets when 2 or more standalone technical phrases appear sequentially WITHOUT conjunctions (and/or/with/of/from/to/in/by/using/through)

quotes: Only split into multiple bullets when: 2 or more standalone technical phrases appear sequentially, AND there is NO conjunction

acceptanceCriteria: Input 'light absorption glucose formation oxygen release' produces three separate bullets
Each bullet is a complete phrase (e.g., 'Light absorption by chlorophyll')
Sequential phrases without conjunctions are correctly identified and split

requirements.text: Preserve complete sentences as single bullets when they contain subject + verb + descriptive clause or process explanation, preventing fragmentation

quotes: If a sentence contains: subject + verb, descriptive clause, process explanation, Then DO NOT split into multiple bullets

acceptanceCriteria: Sentences with clear subject-verb-object structure remain as single bullets
Process explanations are not fragmented mid-explanation
Descriptive clauses stay attached to their subjects

requirements.text: Implement validation rules to prevent single-word bullets, conjunction-led bullets, and modifier-separated bullets in all conversion modes

quotes: Prevent: single-word bullets, conjunction-led bullets, modifier-separated bullets

acceptanceCriteria: No bullet contains only a single word
No bullet begins with a standalone conjunction
Modifiers are not separated from their nouns into different bullets

requirements.text: Apply semantic grouping before bullet conversion and prioritize meaning preservation over formatting in all three conversion modes: Convert Paragraph to Points, Convert to Bullet Points, and Definition Style Format

quotes: Apply bullet conversion AFTER semantic grouping
Apply this logic globally to: Convert Paragraph to Points, Convert to Bullet Points, Definition Style Format

acceptanceCriteria: Semantic analysis completes before any bullet formatting is applied
All three conversion modes use the same smart semantic engine
Meaning of academic content is preserved even if fewer bullets are generated
Logical phrase boundaries are respected across all conversion modes

constraints: Do not modify Headings Auto Detect functionality
Do not change Download Button behavior
Do not change Reset Output Button behavior
Do not alter UI Layout or component structure of NotesCleanerPage
nonGoals: Adding new formatting options beyond bullet conversion improvements
Modifying other pages or components outside Notes Cleaner
Changing the visual design or styling of the Notes Cleaner interface
